summary: Iteration 12 covered the Admin Console login gate (UI and backend), the token-gated label sheet, the admin token on /ws/admin, and the weekly merchant report email (settings, real send through Emergent managed Resend, cooldown, scheduler code review). Backend: the full suite run with -n 0 gave 140 passed and 0 failed; 1 real-send test was deselected because of the cooldown. The new suite tests/test_admin_gating_weekly_email.py passed 10/10 in a separate run that included one real send for mer-2 (status 'sent' to delivered@resend.dev, then 429 on the second call). Frontend: every requested flow passed on a 375px viewport. /admin, /admin/merchants and /admin/route/<id> are gated. Merchant credentials are rejected with the message 'This page needs the dispatch admin account'. Admin login loads all dashboard sections and the session survives a reload. print-labels-button opens labels.html?token=... with labels in it. Sign-out returns to the sign-in screen. Driver and Customer consoles open without login. LowRatingAlerts updated live over the token WebSocket: a 1-star rating appeared without a reload. Weekly email card: the switch toggles on and off and weekly-email-next changes, send-now updated weekly-email-last, and the second press showed the cooldown toast. No bugs blocking the requested features. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch) were found.

minor.issue: The store is marked as sent for the week (weekly_sent_week) before send_weekly_report runs. If the provider fails or the email is paused for credits, that week is never retried, and the only trace is a 'failed' log row.
The 5-minute cooldown also counts manual attempts that failed, for example when public_base is unknown or the provider errored. The merchant has to wait 5 minutes to retry after a failure.

Email links are built from X-Forwarded-Host/Host stored in db.settings. A spoofed X-Forwarded-Host was overwritten by the ingress in this preview, so it is safe here. It still depends on the proxy; a fixed public base URL from env would be safer for production.
The CSV token in the weekly email (sub 'weekly:<mid>', valid 7 days) is not tied to a user. Disabling the store login or resetting its password does not revoke links already sent.

Older log (code from before the current version) shows a BulkWriteError E11000 on code_redemptions.code in seed_history when resets run at the same time. This is a pre-existing race, not reproduced in this run.

issues: The card renders null while loading and on query error (if (!w) return null), so there is no loading or error state. A failed GET makes the card disappear silently.
The Switch hit area is 40x20. The surrounding Pressable row (minHeight 48) toggles too, so it is acceptable.
A merchant who is already signed in and opens /admin sees the plain admin sign-in form, with no hint that they are signed in as a merchant. Signing in as admin replaces the merchant session.

action_items: Optional: only set weekly_sent_week after a successful send, or retry failed scheduled sends later on Monday.
Optional: leave failed manual sends out of the send-now cooldown.
Optional: give WeeklyEmailCard loading and error states (ErrorBlock with retry).
Optional: build email links from a configured public base URL rather than request headers.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2600+ lines; split it into routers (auth, merchants/reports, weekly email, routes, alerts).
next_weekly_send and report_window('lastweek') are correct: next Monday 08:00 America/Los_Angeles, and the previous Monday to Sunday.
The scheduler claims each store atomically per ISO week, so it is safe with multiple workers. It skips stores with weekly_email false, and runs Monday >= 08:00 SF, checking every 60s.
_assert_safe_email guards are good (no forms, https-only links, no shorteners, anchor text must match the link host).
Driver, Customer and tracking endpoints (arrive/deliver/fail/rating/window) stay unauthenticated by design. Anyone can deliver or rate a stop.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_future_days_summary_labels.py (labels via labels-link token; unknown route without token -> 401)

success_rate.backend: 100% (140/140 full suite; real-send test passed in a separate run)

seed_data_creation: None. Tests use the seeded demo accounts and POST /api/admin/reset. Real emails went to the managed redirect delivered@resend.dev: mer-2 once from pytest and mer-1 once from the UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0. When running in the background, use setsid: a plain nohup gets killed after 120s. send-now has a 5-minute cooldown per store (db.report_emails, trigger manual) that survives admin/reset. The backend's WatchFiles reloads on edits to tests/. conftest injects an admin token for admin-only paths. Use the raw Session.request (captured at import) to test 401/403.
rca_of_issue: The expected failures from iteration 11 came from contract changes, not app bugs. labels.html now needs the labels-link token, and ws/admin needs ?token=. The suites were updated and now pass. TestReport's leftover active routes are fixed by resetting in the fixture.
